summary: Generate one purpose-specific canonical client-control result format for Rust, TypeScript and Swift

replay.detail: Canonical helpers and wire models do not change store replay or migrate existing claims.

schema.detail: Adds closed visible-state, signed-result binding and per-run control-grant wire models. Granted commands carry grant/run metadata; result requests optionally carry a binding and existing DeviceSignature envelope.

rules.detail: The client.device-result.v1 domain binds command kind, enrolled device and pairing session, grant, run, command id, outcome, error and RFC 8785 visible-state digest. It is never message.send authority and requires no control.messages scope.

compatibility.detail: The existing phone.inspect and phone.navigate verb names are shared by all test-client kinds. Legacy ungranted request/result shapes remain decodable. All clients share fixed-key golden vectors and cross-domain rejection tests.

downtime.detail: Source-only contract generation requires no live setup, enrollment, daemon or pairing changes.

manual.detail: Regenerate checked-in canonical outputs with cargo run -p fractal-client-codegen. Fixture key scalar and signing nonce are public test material, never production identities.

recovery.detail: No persisted data or runtime state is changed by canonical source generation.
